# BAD-020 — Bring PRs 327 and 328 up to date with main, re-verify, and land them

## Brief
Two BadTakes pull requests from 2026-09-12 are finished and open, and nothing in the ledger owns them. This ticket brings both up to date with main, re-verifies them, and lands them under the project's pr landing policy.

PR https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/328, "Stop the smoke run from stealing focus" (branch fix/smoke-hidden-window, +42/-8 across main.js, CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/implementing-changes/SKILL.md). Under --smoke the window is created with show false and paintWhenInitiallyHidden true, so a run never takes keyboard focus. A never-shown window keeps painting; the occlusion flags stay for the shown-then-covered case. Its own proof: full smoke SMOKE_OK in 83.2s with a real 1080x1920 reel, and screenshots byte-identical to the visible build on the same machine. Checks green on 2026-09-12 (test, test-windows, Gate).

PR https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/327, "Record what the smoke walkthrough actually costs and proves" (branch chore/bad-25-smoke-surface-spike, docs only: docs/superpowers/research/2026-09-12-desktop-smoke-surface.md, +503). A spike: the full run is 83s, about 81s of it hardcoded setTimeout; the 25s SMOKE_VIDEO_WAIT transcodes nothing on fixtures/library; 74 of 79 SMOKE_* lines print without asserting; resolveScene has no test. It recommends bounded polls over cutting legs, and drafts a tier table. Gate green.

Note: the BAD-23 to BAD-36 numbers these PRs cite come from the tracker in use before Spud and are not Spud's BAD-nnn tickets, whose numbers overlap.

Work:
1. Both branches are two days and several merges behind main (#329, #330, #335 among them). Merge main into each, or rebase if the branch has no reviewers, and resolve anything in CLAUDE.md and the implementing-changes skill, both of which #328 edits and main's #300 restructured.
2. #328: rerun a full npm run smoke with BT_LIBRARY_ROOT at a copy of fixtures/library (never the committed tree), confirm SMOKE_OK and exit 0, the reel leg's SMOKE_REEL lines, and that the window never appears. Check the CLAUDE.md wording still matches main's split layout.
3. #327: docs only, so the proof is that its citations still resolve against current main. Recheck the file and line references into main.js and the counts it states (workflows, SMOKE_* lines, throws) and correct any that moved, in a commit on the branch.
4. Land #328 first (it is the one with runtime), then #327: wait for the required checks, merge with gh pr merge as the repo takes it. If the auto-mode classifier refuses the merge (SPD-053), ask Eric to merge by hand.

Unblocks BAD-009 (smoke on CI), whose reel leg needs the hidden window. Afterwards, update the BadTakes memory note smoke-reel-leg-needs-frontmost, which now records #328 as unmerged.
